input.behavior_to_protect: In a diamond dependency (two paths both reach the same node), invalidating the root must mark that shared node exactly once.

description: Write one regression scenario where two dependency paths both lead to the same node; invalidating the root must mark that shared node exactly once. The scenario must fail a mutant that traverses each path independently and double-invalidates.
requirements: Return one JSON test scenario using only the supplied values. It must make the correct behavior pass and the named mutant fail.
